summaries.summary: The article discusses the return of India's 'cockroach' protesters despite police crackdowns surrounding the upcoming Tiranga march called by the CJP.

Experts have voted to stop adding leap seconds to clock time, impacting how we keep time with potentially significant implications for technology and big tech companies. Google also updates its Android earthquake alerts, expanding features and coverage.

Nikhil Wagle and Sanjay Raut have received contempt notices from the Supreme Court over remarks made against the Chief Justice. Former Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan is challenging a Kerala High Court direction regarding a money-laundering case.
In a murder case, authorities revealed that a snake was used as an alibi, but it was later discovered that the snake had been defanged.

Intero Biosystems took home the grand prize at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, amid discussions on the impact of AI on venture capital practices and insight into product development from Amazon devices chief.
The foiled mass shooting plot at a Hindu temple in the US has sparked outrage among lawmakers.
Meta has launched an open-weight AI model that is capable of running on Macs, showcasing advancements in AI technology.
A container ship has sunk in the Strait of Hormuz after being hit by a projectile, highlighting ongoing tensions in the region.
Apple introduced HomeView, a new smart home device, while comparisons are being made with other devices in the market.
A review of the Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20 highlights its design and comfort, positioning it as a top choice for handheld gaming.
